name: AMIYA Corporation
summary: AMIYA Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells cybersecurity products and services. The company designs and operates information security and network infrastructure products; develops and sells security and Saas cloud network products; and detects, assesses, and operates cyber security products. It also operates information system services. In addition, the company offers ALog ConVerter, a server access log management system; ALog ConVerter DB, a database log management system; ALog EVA, an integrated data management tool; and Resource Athlete, a server management system.
